'''Focusing coils''' were components used in [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weaponry. The coils helped the weapon maintain a cohesive blaster bolt during the firing process. Blasters such as the [[Defender sporting blaster pistol/Legends|Defender sporting blaster pistol]] had focusing coils in their [[final stage collimator barrel]]s, while weapons such as the [[T-21 light repeating blaster/Legends|T-21 light repeating blaster]] and the [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]] had the coils spread along the length of the [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]].<ref name="EGWT" />
